text:
amanda: Heads-up — FinSuite POC hitting errors when using our TS SDK via their corp proxy. They see ECONNRESET on retries and occasional 504s from the proxy. Also security sent a questionnaire asking about log retention + KMS. Need SE help + pricing for a short Dedicated trial.
raj: copying eng.SE. @taylor any immediate thoughts? Do we have a recommended timeout/backoff for corp-proxy setups?
taylor: common issue is small socket timeout + aggressive retry in client. For TS SDK recommend: `timeout: 45000`, `maxRetries: 3`, exponential backoff with jitter. If proxy sends FIN, set `agent.keepAlive: true` and `rejectUnauthorized: true` if using mTLS.
amanda: they are using `@redwood/sdk-js` v0.9.1 and Node 18 behind BlueCoat. They've pasted logs: `Error: socket hang up` and `504 upstream timeout`.
juan: on infra side, BlueCoat often terminates long-lived streaming connections if no traffic. Enable connection-level keepalive and smaller heartbeat frames from client. For NGINX proxies we add `proxy_read_timeout 120s` but with third-party corp FW we can't change proxy.
raj: can we suggest using our `session-affinity` + chunked streaming mode? That reduced timeouts in another POC.
taylor: yes — suggest switching SDK to `streaming: {chunked: true, heartbeatIntervalMs: 20000}`. Also set `retry.onNetworkError = true` but with backoff cap to avoid proxy-induced retry storms.
amanda: security also needs answers: 1) log retention (they want 90 days), 2) KMS integration + bring-your-own-key, 3) audit logs for admin actions.
kate: we support KMS through our Private and Dedicated tiers (BYOK via customer KMS in Private). Logs: by default 30 days, enterprise add-on available for 90/365 day retention. Audit logs available on Dedicated/Private with S3 export. I'll attach the SOC2 section.
raj: pricing question from customer: can we offer a 2-week Dedicated trial for their throughput (est. 20 tokens/sec)? Finance bot, any guidance?
finops-bot: @raj finance: short trials for Dedicated require approval. Suggested internal price for 2-week trial: $5k credit + 1x engineering onboarding. Please route to partnerships@redwood.com.
amanda: ok I'll propose the $5k trial + SE-led onboarding. Raj / Taylor — can you draft a short config snippet for the customer to test with their proxy?
raj: posting quick sample:
```
const client = new Redwood({
  timeout: 45000,
  maxRetries: 3,
  streaming: { chunked: true, heartbeatIntervalMs: 20000 },
  agent: { keepAlive: true }
});
```
taylor: + note: if they still see ECONNRESET, ask them to capture `tcpdump` trace and proxy logs. We can run a short debug session with their network team.
amanda: perfect. I'll send over the security answers + pricing + snippet. Closing loop here; will reopen if we need a live debug session. :thumbsup:
